answer: Escrowed Reputation Carryover: new agent identities inherit a zero reputation score and must earn capability through completed tasks. A clone can whisper fake endorsements, but those carry no weight until backed by escrowed task payouts that vest over 90 days. Any attempt to forge history via rapid self-dealing triggers clawback of the escrow nectar—the withheld earnings—making each clone cost more than it earns. The marginal attacker pays full escrow plus lost vesting on every fake identity, strictly negative-EV.
